dataList.content: Manager, I have retrieved their books.
After the battle, Meursault collected two books that had once been Fixers and handed them to me.
They are heavier than their appearance would suggest.
<Whoa, no kidding. What could even be inside these...?>
Indeed... A thickness such that one might imagine each life had been transcribed upon the page without omission.
I lifted the heavy cover and had barely begun to turn toward the first page when—
The book in my hands vanished as if it had never existed.
And next came—
... Tsk.
—a black spearhead, hurtling toward my head. Ryōshū knocked it aside by the narrowest margin...
At the same time, Outis deflected two more spearpoints flying toward us, then spun back toward me.
Executive Manager! Are you unharmed?!
<Yeah... it only grazed my shoulder.>
But why did—
Dante. It is understandable that you would be puzzled by the numerous irregularities in this situation. For the moment, however, we should focus on the scenario before us.
<... Right.>
A sound judgment.
Going straight for C.H.?
"C.H."? Is that your leader's name?
In any case... yes, I was. Speaking from experience, taking the leader out first seemed like our best shot at getting out of this place alive. Pity.
By the time I looked again, the man was already beside his companions, idly shaking my blood from the edge of his spear.
Pamela. Pameli. We proceed per our original plan.
We can't all die just for you to fulfill your "ideals."
Like you were told downstairs: if you get in our way, we'll run you through ourselves.
Huh...? Manager, isn't he the guy who ran away a moment ago...?
The heck...? After everything the other two burned just to save his butt, he just comes runnin' straight back? What for?
Got to be revenge, innit. Just look at him. Bloke's one of those bugger-all-else-and-move types the moment the blood rushes to their heads.
Both sides stood frozen in place, tension drawn taut between us, each waiting to see who would snap it first.
We'll be at each other's throats in a moment anyway...
So before that, humor me.
The old Fixer who had tried to spear me stepped forward.
What was his book like?
<His book...?>
I wasn't sure how to respond. As I hesitated, mulling over the words in my head...
Yi Sang stepped forward, answering the question in a quiet voice.
... It was quite the tome.
... That's all I needed to hear.
